entries.def: 1 (of people or their actions) feeling or showing great desire to harm others; malevolent
2 (a) (of a tumour) growing uncontrol-lably, and likely to prove fatal: The growth is not malignant. (b) (of diseases) harmful to life.
1 [U] state of being malignant. 2 [C] malignant tumour.
1 Someone or something that is hairy is covered with hair
2 If you describe a situation as hairy, you mean, that it is exciting, worrying, and rather frightening; a very informal use.
entries.example: It got a little hairy when we drove him to the station with less than two minutes to spare.
